body:
Stardew Valley says "another player of your choice may gain control of that permanent". You choose the player.

Old: `APlayerMayAction(Other(You), GainControlOfPermanent(Ref_TargetPermanent))`
New: `ChooseAPlayer(Other(You)), PlayerMayAction(TheChosenPlayer, GainControlOfPermanent(Ref_TargetPermanent))`

comments.body:
``APlayerMayAction`` has an implied ``ChooseAPlayer(..)``. (vs. ``PlayerMayAction`` where there isn't a choice, ``EachPlayerMayAction`` where all players take action, or ``AnyPlayerMayCost`` where the players get to choose not you).

No plan changed.

title: Stardew Valley: "player of your choice" isn't chosen by you
